content:
Alex K: Heads-up: Emerald trial kickoff this week. Quick sync — timeline, owners, blockers?
Maria (SE): Thanks — can someone confirm network peering WHITELIST IPs? SE team needs egress rules.
Sam Eng: I can own the infra side. Need VPC peering creds + expected throughput. Any target qps?
Tara (Solutions): Customer expects 100 qps sustained during demo windows, spikes to 250. Also needs model pinned to rdm-3b-quant.
Jordan SRE: We should reserve Dedicated pool for trial days to guarantee latency. @Sam Eng can you open a reserved-cap request?
Sam Eng: Opened ticket INF-9876. ETA for pool: 48 hrs after approvals.
Maria (SE): Also need webhook callback integration — they require mutual TLS. Do we have certs for their domain?
Alex K: Tara can share contact to exchange certs. Also, can someone review the PR that adds mTLS to webhook connector? @Sam Eng
Sam Eng: I'll review now. Quick note: code changes in `webhooks/client.py` — added `ssl_context.load_cert_chain(...)` — LGTM but will run tests.
```
# minimal snippet from staging run
client = WebhookClient(url)
client.ssl_context.load_cert_chain(certfile, keyfile)
resp = client.post(payload)
```
deploy-bot: deploy queued: emerald-trial/mtls-hook -> staging (sha: a1b2c3).
Sam Eng: Deployed to staging, ran integration smoke: POST /callback returns 200 with client cert check.
Tara (Solutions): Customer wants success criteria: 95th p90 < 120ms gen latency, embedding similarity recall > 0.9, and zero 5xx in webhook events for demo. Capturing in trial doc.
Maria (SE): Notes: Need to run compatibility test against their NLP pipeline — shared script at https://redwood.atlassian.org/emerald/tests
Alex K: :thumbsup: OK — owners: Sam = infra/deploy, Maria = integration, Tara = customer ops, Jordan = SRE oncall. Any other blockers?
Jordan SRE: Can we get API keys rotation window scheduled? Avoid rotating during demo window. Proposed: rotate Monday 00:30 UTC.
Tara (Solutions): Confirmed — scheduled outside demo. I'll send calendar invites.
Alex K: Closing loop — Sam, update INF-9876 with peering IPs and reserved pool ETA. Maria, drop final test script in trial doc. Ping here once done.
Sam Eng: Will update by EOD. /cc @deploy-bot
Maria (SE): Uploaded tests and a short runbook. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.org/emerald/runbook — runbook includes curl commands and expected responses.
Alex K: Perfect. Thanks everyone :tada:
